targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-951c (2026-09-03) NON-CONTRIBUTORY -- the diagnostic PASSED and its answer is CORRECT BUT NON-DISCRIMINATING. In all 9 P2 cells (27,000 ticks) gate_energy, gate_drive and gate_pe each read mean == min == max == 1.0 exactly. Since tonic_vigor.py computes v_t = max(v_t_floor, max(0,v_raw) * gE * gD * gP), a gate product of 1.0 makes `v_t == floor` ENTAIL `max(0,v_raw) <= floor` -- the probe's raw_caused branch condition -- so gate_caused had zero reachable ticks at any sample size and the reported 0/25787 restates the measured gate state. The gate state is MEASURED, not assumed, so the run is not empty; what it cannot support is the framing that it adjudicated raw-versus-gate causation. The branch is not dead in general: in P1 training (instrumented but EXCLUDED from the pool) gate_caused fired on 2 of 6348 floor-hits on seed 43. The run's single non-degeneracy key, gate_caused_classification, is bool(sufficient_sample and gc_frac is not None) -- sample size and a non-null denominator only -- so nothing in the gate tests outcome reachability, and the post-fix --dry-run produced the IDENTICAL label. THE SUBSTANTIVE, NON-DEGENERATE FINDINGS: (1) on seeds 42 and 45, v_raw max is EXACTLY 0.0 in all six cells (means -14.26 and -22.97) -- the ungated EWMA is negative on every tick, so v_t is pinned at the floor before any gate is consulted; (2) action_density reads 1.0 in all 9 cells, leaving a vigor bias no headroom to raise action rate; (3) the internal-state gates are pinned open on the UNCALMED predecessor bed too (V3-EXQ-951, gate_product_mean 1.0 in all 18 occurrences), so their thresholds are never met by this substrate's dynamics on either bed. MECH-320's stated re-check condition -- 'a re-posed successor with a DV that can move' -- is therefore NOT met. PROCESS NOTE for governance: V3-EXQ-951's third precondition baseline_no_op_opportunity, the check that made 951 a FAIL, is absent from 951c, whose driver declassifies it as 'not this script's DV', while action_density remains 1.0 in all nine of 951c's own cells. Whether a successor on a different DV may drop a predecessor's blocking precondition while the condition it detected persists is a governance question, not an autopsy verdict.

learning_extracted: A non-degeneracy flag can certify a diagnostic while being blind to the diagnostic's actual limitation: gate_caused_classification tests sample size and a non-null denominator, never outcome reachability.
A smoke test cannot catch this class -- the post-fix --dry-run produced the identical label, because the emitted label is reachable and only the ALTERNATIVE label is not.

The internal-state gates are pinned fully open on BOTH the calmed and uncalmed beds, so the gate thresholds (drive > 0.7, energy < 0.2, pe > 1.0) are simply never met by this substrate's dynamics. An earlier draft attributed the pinning to this run's bed calming; the predecessor's own manifest refutes that and the stronger reading replaces it.

ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT is defined at driver lines 193-202 but never referenced and never emitted, and its text argues reachability of the two PRECONDITIONS, not of the two classification OUTCOMES -- a reachability guard aimed at the wrong object.
This driver carries no '=== HYPOTHESES UNDER TEST ===' / '=== INTERPRETATION GRID ===' block, unlike ten other drivers in the corpus.

failure_location.net_classification: MIXED (MEASURES + ENVIRONMENT) -- not chargeable to REE. The mechanism was never placed in a condition where it could act.

The dropped baseline_no_op_opportunity precondition is a governance-process question (may a successor declassify the precondition that failed its predecessor, while the underlying condition persists?) rather than a claim disposition. Recommend a governance_flag; not adjudicated here.
